outcome: Spontaneous preterm birth in a subsequent pregnancy
cohort: Women who had two consecutive births at Royal Prince Alfred Hospital, 1989-2015
finding: Women who had a caesarean section at full dilatation had a significantly higher rate of subsequent spontaneous preterm birth compared with women who had a caesarean section during the first stage of labor.
